beats.care: Winter smog usually hits in November. The government wants offices to allow WFH and people to take the Metro on bad days.
beats.what: Delhi recorded 211 good, satisfactory or moderate air days by October 17, Environment Minister Manjinder Singh Sirsa said.
beats.why: It's the best count since 2016, leaving out Covid-hit 2020. Poor-or-worse days fell from 168 in 2016 to 79.

cards.body: In the same stretch of 2016, Delhi had 168 such days.
cards.caption: poor, very poor or severe days so far in 2026

cards.body: Sirsa said 'this is not a moment for complacency.' Low winter winds trap smoke and dust, so he called the coming months the real challenge.
cards.title: Not done yet

opts: Slow winter winds let pollution build up
cards.q: Why does the government call winter 'the real test'?
cards.why: Sirsa said lower wind speeds in winter are the real challenge for Delhi's air.

cards.q: Have you noticed cleaner air this year?

hook: Has Delhi had its *cleanest air year in a decade* so far?

learn.t: By October 17, Delhi had more good-to-moderate air days than in all of 2025, which had 200.

tldr: Delhi has logged 211 days of good-to-moderate air so far in 2026, but the government says winter will be the real test.
watch: CAQM has given MCD until October 31 to clear dust and construction debris from roads and open plots.
